==Ingredients==

*Slices of [[Cookbook:bread|bread]] (3 per person)
*3 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoon]]s [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
*3 shakes [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
*3 shakes ground [[Cookbook:oregano|oregano]] leaves

==Procedure==

# Remove crusts from bread, and add other ingredients onto a microwave safe plate.
# Make each slice of bread into ball, and lay on same plate.
# Microwave plate for 25 seconds, wait 30 seconds, and serve.
